note_fullstack: The reference serves the UI from FastAPI on the same origin as the API (app_base_url == api_base_url). A submission that runs a separate React dev/preview server sets its own app_base_url.

transport.note: Each operationId maps to the REST method+path below (FastAPI backend). Path params interpolate into the URL; body params go in the JSON body; query params in the query string. Set operation_id= on each route. The React UI at app_base_url is what the interaction journeys drive.

auth.note: Auth is implemented by the app. The harness registers via the register operation, logs in to receive a token, then sends 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' on authenticated API calls. The UI stores the token and guards protected pages.
